reviews.title: Difficult to get in contact
reviews.text: I've been trying to book a ticket from Curacao to Paramaribo, but the payment system on their website isn't working. Even after trying with different creditcards we still receive a failed payment status. I've triend to call them several times as well as sending an email, but I just can't get a hold of them. Poor customer service...
reviews.author: mdek13

reviews.title: Friendly
reviews.text: Good aircraft, friendly service. Airline would only take “cash” money upon purchase of ticket. On one flight they called me to tell me the plane was leaving 2 hrs early... it didn’t. On the return flight we left 1 hour earlier than the time on my ticket. Wanted to travel with them again...... but there is no return flight for my destination ?!
reviews.author: stephen b
